name: ideas
description: Turn a raw idea into an audited spec and plan with a source skeleton, versioned manifest, typed dependency graph, and optional GitHub issues.

interface.shortDescription: Build audited plans with skeletons and graphs
interface.longDescription: Run a scope-sized, ledger-backed interview; produce an audited design spec with EARS acceptance criteria; then create a canonical plan, source skeleton, versioned manifest, and typed dependency graph for execution or GitHub projection.
defaultPrompt: Interview me to turn this rough idea into a spec.
Turn an approved design spec into an implementation plan with a source skeleton and dependency graph.
Project this Ideas plan into GitHub tickets.
